originalInstructions.description: Reconcile all six unresolved Claude review threads on morning-cockpit PR #54 (MC-UX-01 design handoff capture). Address: T1–T7/core-gate crosswalk using the Codex follow-up's qualified crosswalk (do not assume all T1–T6 are ungated/read-only), capture verifier in CI with byte guards, merge-method/pin handling, local AGENTS attribution, deviation numbering, and published local paths. Record a fix or reasoned disposition for each thread. Keep the PR draft — this task does not request a merge or UI/executor implementation.

Clarify the 8 repositories not covered by the fleet-runner PR-gate sweep (core #509 covered 16 of 24). These are now identified as private repos where the current GitHub license tier does not allow branch protection rules. File a follow-up issue in core to determine: (a) why the fleet-runner inspection did not surface this constraint in its output or PR description, (b) whether the daily-logger runner missed the context or whether it was never captured in documentation or decision records, and (c) next steps — evaluate a license tier upgrade to enable branch protection on private repos, or record an explicit risk-acceptance decision.

Daily-logger editorial UI: the `+` icon button next to section-level editorial text area inputs does not function. No clean interface exists for adding multiple editorial entries per section — all notes must be freeformed into one paragraph. This degrades readability, agent parseability, and introduces data-loss risk. Request a proper UX design and delivery work cycle to ship an improved multi-entry editorial input interface.

Accept ADR-0079 (vault-lifecycle policy) and re-evaluate ADR-0080 (scanner acceptance criteria) against the scanner PR description from core PR #121. ADR-0079 must be accepted first — it is the prerequisite. Both ADRs have been in Proposed state since their governing PRs merged in September; the gap erodes the audit trail. This is housekeeping, not blocking any current implementation work.
